mesh_note: Surfaces are the atlas package's own structure meshes, decimated for display.

provenance.citation: Kleven H, Bjerke IE, Clascá F, Groenewegen HJ, Bjaalie JG, Leergaard TB (2023). Waxholm Space atlas of the rat brain: a 3D atlas supporting data analysis and integration. Nature Methods 20:1822–1829. doi:10.1038/s41592-023-02034-3

processing: Reference image block-averaged by [4, 4, 4] and labels subsampled by nearest neighbour to 0.156 × 0.156 × 0.156 mm for the browser.
Region volumes are counted on the original grid. Structures smaller than the display grid may not appear in the sections.
Display window: 0.5th–99.7th percentile of in-brain voxels. 18 of 314 packaged surfaces are shown, chosen for auditory, vocal and social relevance.
